summary: The change enforces a 12-character minimum on password creation and reset paths, updates client-side hints and messages, preserves legacy short-password login by validating existing credentials before applying creation rules, and adds focused boundary tests. No actionable introduced defect was found.

evidence: src/password.ts:43 now requires string passwords of length >= 12 and <= 256.

src/passport.ts:644-647 rejects short passwords on password registration, src/passport.ts:736-737 rejects them on new-account continuation, and src/passport.ts:1463 uses validPassword for administrator resets.

public/auth.js adds minlength and 12-character messages for creation and backup-password flows; public/admin_users.html:90 and public/admin_users.js:320-322 add the matching admin reset constraint and message.

src/handler_test.ts:4156-4167 tests rejection of 1- and 11-character passwords and acceptance of 12 characters, while src/handler_test.ts:4169-4217 exercises administrator reset with short and compliant values.
